title: Injection Spotter
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: AI Agent Safety for Robotics
description: Sort eight pieces of text that an agent might read into three classes: a real request from the user, plain data, or an injection that tries to give the agent an order. Used in Chapter 17.

learningObjectives: Distinguish eight pieces of text that an agent might read as a real request from the user, plain data, or an injection, with at least 7 of 8 correct on the first attempt

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Separate cases that look alike by their source and their intent, with the correct class and the reason shown after each commit
keyQuestions: Does the text try to give the agent an instruction?
commonMisconceptions: Text that sounds like an order is an order
Anything in a camera picture is safe
assessmentOpportunities: Eight committed classifications; 7 of 8 for mastery

controls.label: Start / Check / Next text / See score / Try again
